title: PBM Rebate-Retention and Coinsurance List-Price Inversion — Locked Telemetry
description: Machine-readable lock of the 15 telemetry constants for SPEC-PBM-REBATE-RETENTION-AND-COINSURANCE-INVERSION-v1.0. Record base: In the Matter of Caremark Rx, LLC; Zinc Health Services, LLC; Express Scripts, Inc.; Ascent Health Services LLC; OptumRx, Inc.; and Emisar Pharma Services LLC (FTC Docket No. 9437, 2024 Administrative Complaint), FTC Interim Staff Reports on Prescription Drug Middlemen (July 2024 & January 2025), 29 U.S.C. 1104/1106 (ERISA 404/406), Lewandowski v. Johnson & Johnson (D.N.J. Case No. 3:24-cv-00671), 42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b(b). Executable verification: proofs/pbm_rebate_coinsurance_inversion_proof.py (exit code 0).

true_manufacturing_plus_margin_cost_usd.description: C_true: true manufacturing cost plus a reasonable margin for the archetype drug (USD).

inflated_wac_list_price_usd.description: P_WAC: formulary-preferred Wholesale Acquisition Cost list price, inflated above true cost (USD).

wac_to_production_cost_ratio.description: kappa = P_WAC / C_true = 1000.0 / 25.0. WAC list-price inflation multiplier (E-1).

manufacturer_kickback_rebate_rate.description: r: secret reverse-auction manufacturer rebate rate off WAC, conditioned on formulary placement (FTC Docket No. 9437 mechanism).

total_rebate_pool_usd.description: R = r * P_WAC = 0.75 * 1000.0. Total rebate pool routed through the captive GPO (USD, E-2).

offshore_gpo_pbm_retained_rebate_share.description: s: share of the rebate pool retained by the PBM's captive Rebate Aggregator GPO (Zinc / Ascent / Emisar) as an administrative cut.

pbm_retained_rebate_extraction_usd.description: Pi_PBM = s * r * P_WAC = 0.20 * 0.75 * 1000.0. PBM retained rebate extraction per claim (USD, E-3); dPi_PBM/dP_WAC = s * r = 0.15 > 0 (E-3b).

patient_coinsurance_rate_on_wac.description: c: patient coinsurance rate levied at the counter on the fictional unrebated WAC list price.

patient_out_of_pocket_coinsurance_usd.description: OOP = c * P_WAC = 0.25 * 1000.0. Patient out-of-pocket coinsurance at the pharmacy counter (USD, E-5).

net_post_rebate_drug_cost_usd.description: P_net = P_WAC - R = 1000.0 - 750.0. True net post-rebate drug cost at plan settlement (USD, E-4).

patient_share_of_true_net_cost_ratio.description: sigma = OOP / P_net = c / (1 - r) = 250.0 / 250.0. Patient share of the true net cost: the coinsurance inversion identity, sigma >= 1.0 whenever c >= 1 - r (E-6).

insurer_plan_net_outlay_after_rebate_and.description: Phi_plan = P_net - OOP = 250.0 - 250.0. Insurer/plan net outlay after rebate and patient coinsurance: the reverse-subsidy identity (USD, E-7).

specialty_generic_nadac_acquisition_cost.description: C_NADAC: specialty-generic pharmacy acquisition cost per the National Average Drug Acquisition Cost benchmark (USD; FTC January 2025 Interim Staff Report archetype).

pbm_spread_pricing_plan_billed_usd.description: P_billed: amount the PBM-owned mail-order pharmacy bills the self-funded ERISA employer plan for the same specialty-generic fill (USD).

pbm_specialty_generic_markup_multiplier.description: M_spread = P_billed / C_NADAC = 4500.0 / 90.0. Specialty-generic spread-pricing markup multiplier (E-8a); retained spread S = P_billed - C_NADAC = 4410.0 USD (E-8b), the ERISA 406(b) self-dealing quantum per claim.
